name: PHT Stablecoin
oneLiner: PHT is APACX's Philippine peso CDP stablecoin using approved stablecoin collateral such as USDC/USDT, with apcxUSDT live in beta transparency.
collateral: MakerDAO-style CDP vaults using approved stablecoin collateral, with USDC/USDT described for the initial stage; APACX transparency currently lists apcxUSDT and planned apcxUSDC beta reserve wallets.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP vaults (MakerDAO MCD fork): users deposit approved collateral to mint PHT; undercollateralized vaults liquidate through independent Dutch auctions; live stablecoin paths divide Chainlink stablecoin/USD numerators by an owner-set APACX PHP/USD denominator; LayerZero OFT supports cross-chain bridging

oracleRisk.summary: Five debt-bearing Ethereum ilks were retained. Three divide a Chainlink stablecoin/USD numerator by an owner-set APACX PHP/USD denominator without contract-enforced freshness, while two zero-ceiling legacy ilks with outstanding debt use owner-set APACX feeds directly; liquidation is immediate through independent Dutch auctions.

branchApplicability.rationale: The live ILK Registry enumerated seven independently parameterized Ethereum branches at finalized block 25531795. USDT-A, cPHP-A, ApcxUSDT-A, demoUSDT-A, and USDC-A all retained positive normalized Vat debt and are reviewed below; cPHP-A and demoUSDT-A are retained despite zero debt ceilings. dUSDT-A and dUSDT2-A had both zero normalized debt and zero ceilings and are excluded from current debt-bearing coverage, although their joins, Clips, and Dog configuration remained live and callable.

branches.label: USDT-A
branches.summary: Debt-bearing USDT branch dividing a Chainlink USDT/USD numerator by an owner-set APACX PHP/USD denominator; neither the ratio feed nor Pip enforces source freshness.

feeds.provider: Chainlink numerator and owner-set APACX denominator through ratio DataFeed and Pip
feeds.path: Pip 0xf68658dEc2Ed65D347031852038661Cb572D1B4E -> ratio DataFeed 0x587a9590a78A72c86796bA9C2A369E81268d4284 -> Chainlink USDT/USD 0x3E7d1eAB13ad0104d2750B8863b489D65364e32D divided by owner-set APACX PHP/USD 0x6829AAaFa90739946C62a13eE4A9c5d99baC7aF8

branches.fallbackBehavior: No fallback or stored last-good value. The ratio feed combines a Chainlink numerator with an owner-set PHP/USD denominator; the Pip rejects only a negative result and does not inspect timestamps. The documented 24-hour update policy is not contract-enforced.

collateralParameters.note: Vat normalized debt Art was 6,939.383963243451574983 and the branch debt ceiling was positive. Dog applies a 1% liquidation penalty.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller may immediately bark an unsafe vault through Dog, starting its independent Clip Dutch auction at 120% of the reference price; the auction may reset after 7,200 seconds or after price falls below 75% of its start.
branches.backstop: Auction proceeds cancel debt through Vat/Vow accounting. At the observation block, Vow queued bad debt for 561,600 seconds and required its configured 50 PHT sump before the live Flop could auction APCX recapitalization; Flop was connected to Vow and authorized to mint and burn APCX.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: End was live and ward-cageable. ESM required 10 raw APCX, but its collected Sum and APCX total supply were both zero, so no holder-funded ESM trigger capacity existed at the observation block. Without an authorized cage, residual debt remains in Vat/Vow for the conditional auction path.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Freeze-only re-review: PHT has no confirmed direct holder-balance freeze in reviewed metadata, but resolves to Upstream through apcxUSDT/USDT collateral exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: PHT resolves to Upstream because its backing path includes apcxUSDT/USDT collateral rather than direct token freeze authority.

mintAuthority.summary: PHT's Ethereum deployment mints through a Maker-style DaiJoin and Vat path. Polygon uses an owner-controlled UUPS LayerZero OFT, while Tron uses an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT whose owner can set peers and the LayerZero delegate. Fixed-block deployment supplies put Tron at 15.8053% of the summed observed supply on 2026-07-14. The Polygon and Tron control identities are now sourced, but the Tron peer, endpoint, and cross-chain mint semantics and the Ethereum Vat ward set remain unresolved, so the posture stays unbounded-or-compromised.

controls.label: APACX PHT vault/CDP mint path
controls.capDescription: APACX docs describe PHT minting through MakerDAO-style vaults/CDPs, with beta PHT minted against apcxUSDT collateral and later collateral expansion planned.
controls.evidence: APACX docs describe PHT as a MakerDAO MCD-style stablecoin minted from collateralized vaults, while the beta guide describes current PHT minted using apcxUSDT collateral backed 1:1 by a reserve address.

controls.label: DaiJoin adapter (sole warded minter on PHT ETH)
controls.capDescription: DaiJoin.exit() mints PHT permissionlessly when a user withdraws collateral-backed credit from the Vat; supply is bounded by the Vat's per-ilk debt ceilings set by Vat wards.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295271: PHT token (dai.sol fork, AGPL-3.0) wards(DaiJoin 0x4bd328FD071b03e157d0a89dE199d9E005D71057)=1 (warded). All other checked addresses returned 0: deployer 0x813da81, Vat 0xEE0CDe42, vault contracts 0x59A904af/0x881bA6, EOA 0x76dB01fC. DaiJoin.exit() calls dai.mint(usr, wad) permissionlessly based on Vat internal state. Vat (0xEE0CDe42Bb6841736d809d2Bb63EbF59dB6E336c, live=1) is the CDP engine. DaiJoin.dai()=0xBe370Ad (confirmed PHT token).

controls.label: Vat CDP engine admin (debt ceiling / risk param control)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295271: Vat (vat.sol fork, live=1) controls debt ceilings and risk params via its wards system. Warded address on Vat not located — checked deployer script 0x75CEcF4C, deployer EOA 0x76dB01fC, vault contracts 0x59A904af/0x881bA6, DaiJoin 0x4bd328FD; all returned 0. Vat deployer was contract 0x75CEcF4C (deployed by 0x76dB01fC APACX EOA). If no one is warded, Vat risk params are effectively immutable, but this cannot be positively confirmed.

controls.label: Polygon PHT OFT owner
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90223288, the PHT proxy's EIP-1967 implementation was 0x98210a4b...0618 and its canonical admin slot was zero. The implementation returned the ERC-1967 UUID and contains upgradeToAndCall, confirming UUPS. owner() returned this EOA, which can administer the OFT and authorize upgrades without a resolved timelock or multisig.

controls.label: Tron PHT OFT owner

sources.label: Tronscan API - Tron PHT contract metadata

controls.evidence: Tronscan identifies TXdN5...mmrs as an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT and exposes owner-only setPeer and setDelegate selectors. At Tron block 84456628, owner() returned hex 0xfb99a0af49941ec1ca2fc726be1e287f4c70f5ee, the base58 EOA recorded here. Current peer, endpoint, and mint/burn route semantics were not independently resolved, so the owner's exact durable-supply authority remains unknown.

sources.label: Tronscan API - Tron PHT contract metadata

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25531532 totalSupply was 225,011,899.761301444119160709 PHT through the reviewed Maker-style DaiJoin/Vat deployment. Polygon block 90223288 totalSupply was 11,984,287.03 PHT; that deployment is an owner-controlled UUPS LayerZero OFT. Tron block 84456628 totalSupply was 44,489,605.678905 PHT; Tronscan identifies it as an unverified, non-proxy PhtOFT with an EOA owner able to set peers and the endpoint delegate. Across the summed deployment supplies of 281,485,792.470206444119160709 PHT, Tron represented 15.80527574%, not the stale 19.8% in the curation report. This is an observed deployment-supply materiality basis, not a canonical-circulating reconciliation. The Ethereum Vat ward set and the Tron peer/endpoint/mint route remain unresolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Identify the warded address on the Ethereum Vat CDP engine (0xEE0CDe42Bb6841736d809d2Bb63EbF59dB6E336c), and resolve the Tron PHT trusted peer, LayerZero endpoint/delegate, and cross-chain mint/burn semantics before treating the authority graph as complete.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PHT uses or is linked to LayerZero/OFT-style cross-chain token infrastructure. Because OFT/adapter routes depend on external messaging, endpoint configuration, and lock/mint or burn/mint token contracts outside issuer-native redemption alone, Pharos scores the reviewed route as external lock/mint.
